IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: THE FOUNDATION FOR ANIMAL CARE & EDUCATION WAS FORMED TO ENHANCE AND PRESERVE THE QUALITY OF LIFE OF COMPANION ANIMALS BY PROVIDING ACCESS TO NECESSARY MEDICAL CARE AND EDUCATION.

IRS990.Desc: THE FOUNDATION FOR ANIMAL CARE AND EDUCATION PROVIDES FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO PET OWNERS FOR CRITICAL OR LIFE-SAVING VETERINARY CARE. THE ORGANIZATION SCREENS APPLICANTS/PET OWNERS FOR QUALIFICATION, AND PAYS FOR THE PET'S SURGICAL NEEDS BY NEGOTIATING DISCOUNTED FEES WITH ANIMAL HOSPITALS AND PROVIDING FUNDING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND ACCOUNTING TEAM REVIEW THE FORM 990 BEFORE IT IS FILED. ALL QUESTIONS AND DISCREPANCIES ARE REVIEWED AND DISCUSSED AND THE CPA FIRM IS CONSULTED ON ANY UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS OR CONCERNS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BOARD MEMBERS SIGN A CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE FORM ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. THE POLICY IS ALSO POSTED FOR EMPLOYEES. THE BOARD ENFORCES THE POLICY BY HAVING MEMBERS ABSTAIN FROM ANY VOTE WHERE THERE IS A CONFLICT OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15a
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALTHOUGH FACE DOES NOT HAVE A CEO, THE BOARD PRESIDENT AND BOARD MEMBERS REVIEW SALARY SURVEYS AND COMPARE THEM WITH OTHER SIMILIAR ORGANIZATIONS IN THE FIELD WHEN CONDUCTING COMPENSATION REVIEWS FOR THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD PRESIDENT, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR AND BOARD MEMBERS REVIEW SALARY SURVEYS AND COMPARE THEM WITH OTHER SIMILAR ORGANIZATIONS IN THE FIELD WHEN CONDUCTING COMPENSATION REVIEWS FOR KEY EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section C, Line 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AND POLICIES AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST. ADDITIONALLY, AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS FOR THE 2023 CALENDAR YEAR ARE ALSO AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
